highlights: pros: 10% cashback on online shopping, groceries, beauty/wellness, pet shops/veterinary services and cruises.
pros: Unlimited 0.2% cashback on all other spend.
pros: Complimentary travel insurance of up to S$500,000 when you charge your travel fares to this card.
pros: No annual fees for life + up to 4 supplementary cards with no annual fees.
cons: Minimum spending of S$800 in the statement month to qualify for 10% cashback.
cons: 10% cashback is capped at S$100 per statement month per principal cardmember and up to S$20 per category. Earn 0.2% cashback on all spend when you exceed the cashback cap.

extra.description: The CIMB Visa Signature Card is a unique cashback credit card that allows you to earn 10% cashback on online shopping, groceries, beauty & wellness, pet shops & veterinary services and cruises! Another great thing about it is that you'll never need to pay an annual fee.
